if (typeof CSS !== 'undefined') {
  const escaped: string = CSS.escape('a b');
  const pair: boolean = CSS.supports('display', 'grid');
  const condition: boolean = CSS.supports('(display: grid)');
  const width: number = CSS.px(5).value;
  const registry: HighlightRegistry = CSS.highlights;
  CSS.registerProperty({ name: '--demo', syntax: '<length>', inherits: false, initialValue: '0px' });
  console.log(escaped, pair, condition, width, registry);
} else {
  console.log('CSS is unavailable');
}
try {
  console.log(CSS.escape('x'));
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ReferenceError) console.log(error.name, error.message);
}
